Organic beeswax, coconut oil, and shea butter create a smooth, comfortable balm that glides on easily and helps keep lips soft through cold mornings, holiday shopping, and dry winter weather. Peppermint essential oil and vanilla botanical extract give it its festive aroma with no synthetic fragrance or flavor.

Available individually October through December, Candy Cane is a limited seasonal release made for pockets, stockings, gift exchanges, and keeping close all winter long.

Why You’ll Love It

  • Festive peppermint aroma softened with subtle vanilla
  • Organic beeswax, coconut oil, and shea butter
  • Smooth glide without a sticky or overly waxy feel
  • Helps keep lips soft and comfortable in cold, dry weather
  • No synthetic fragrance
  • No synthetic flavor
  • Pocket-friendly classic twist-up tube
  • Limited seasonal release from October through December
  • Handcrafted in small batches in St. Louis

How to Use

Apply directly to lips whenever they feel dry or need a little extra protection from cold weather.

Reapply as often as needed throughout the day.

Keep one in your coat pocket, purse, or desk drawer for easy winter lip care.

Best Suited For

  • Dry winter lips
  • Peppermint + vanilla lovers
  • Holiday stockings and gift exchanges
  • Small seasonal gifts
  • Everyday cold-weather lip care
  • Anyone who prefers a subtle botanical aroma rather than a sweet flavored balm

Classic oval plastic twist-up tube.

Made with a simple beeswax-based formula and botanical aroma ingredients.

  • Certified organic coconut oil
  • Certified organic shea butter
  • Peppermint essential oil
  • Vanilla botanical extract
  • No synthetic fragrance
  • No synthetic flavor

Handcrafted in St. Louis

Beeswax (Cera alba), Coconut Oil (Cocos nucifera), Shea Butter (Vitellaria paradoxa), Peppermint Essential Oil (Mentha × piperita), Vanilla Botanical Extract (Vanilla planifolia)

description.plain:
WILD PETAL Organic Lip Balm Set

(Jasmine, Geranium, Lilac, Lavender, and Gardenia)

Step into the softness of nature with our Wild Petal Organic Lip Balm Set, a collection of five floral favorites crafted to keep your lips naturally soft, smooth, and comfortable.

Varieties

  1. Jasmine: A soft, sweet blossom aroma that feels delicate, uplifting, and gently floral. We use real, pure jasmine, not a synthetic fragrance.
  2. Geranium: Fresh, rosy botanical notes with a clean, balanced floral scent. We use real, pure geranium.
  3. Lilac: Light, airy springtime fragrance with a subtle, graceful sweetness. We use real lilacs.
  4. Lavender: Calm, soothing floral aroma that feels serene and naturally comforting - and made with real lavender.
  5. Gardenia: A rich, creamy bloom with warm, full-bodied floral depth created from actual gardenia.

These pure-plant balms offer long-lasting moisture without the constant reapplication common with synthetic lip balms. Each formula is made from scratch in small batches using organic oils and botanicals - but never synthetics - so your lips feel more nourished, more conditioned, and beautifully supported with every use. Featuring the delicate aromas, this set brings the gentle elegance of wild blossoms to your daily routine — all with the purity and care Alywillow is known for. These balms are crafted as topical lip moisturizers, not flavored or edible products. While some botanicals carry naturally aromatic notes, no sweeteners or flavoring agents are added.

Ingredients:

Every balm is made from scratch in small batches using an organic, plant-based blend of: organic cold-pressed coconut oil, organic extra virgin high-oleic sunflower oil, organic shea butter, organic beeswax, organic argan oil, organic apricot oil, and therapeutic-grade essential oils for scent. We added real rosemary to our base to make our Rosemary Lip Balm, real cedarwood to make the Cedar Lip Balm, etc.

There are no artificial fragrances, no synthetic chemicals, no artificial colors, and no petroleum-derived ingredients. There are also no artificial waxes, parabens, sulfates, phthalates, mineral oils, petrochemicals, propylene glycol, or alcohol.

Nothing but nature - and your lips will feel the difference.

Botanical Skin Support vs SPF

Each balm glides on with a silky softness, delivering plant-based, bioavailable nutrients that help your lips feel nourished, comforted, and naturally at ease. Crafted from pure organic botanicals, selected for their natural moisturizing properties, these formulas offer gentle Botanical Skin Support™: a plant-based approach to everyday comfort that helps your lips feel healthier and more resilient without relying on synthetic sunscreens or SPF additives. Free of synthetics, our lip balms bring a clean, tender touch to your daily care.

A Moment of Calm for Tired Skin

Some days your skin needs more than hydration—it needs a moment to recover.

Aura is an ultra-fine botanical recovery mist that delivers an instant veil of refreshing hydration while helping comfort, replenish, and revive tired skin. Thoughtfully crafted with rose hydrosol, panthenol, hyaluronic acid, cucumber, aloe, and soothing botanical extracts, every mist leaves skin feeling soft, balanced, and beautifully refreshed.

Whether used after cleansing, throughout the day, after time in the sun, during travel, or whenever your skin feels dry or warm, Aura transforms a simple spritz into a restorative botanical ritual.

Why You'll Love It

Ultra-fine mist for effortless, even application

Instantly refreshes and hydrates

Helps comfort dry, stressed, and dehydrated skin

Lightweight, fast-absorbing, and never sticky

Perfect before moisturizer or anytime skin needs a boost

Suitable for all skin types

Botanical Highlights

Rose Hydrosol – A beautifully aromatic floral water that refreshes and comforts the skin while providing lightweight hydration.

Panthenol (Pro-Vitamin B5) – Helps replenish moisture and supports a soft, healthy-looking complexion.

Hyaluronic Acid – Draws moisture to the skin, leaving it feeling plump, smooth, and refreshed.

Cucumber Extract – Known for its cooling, refreshing feel that helps revive tired-looking skin.

Aloe Vera – Delivers soothing hydration and helps skin feel calm and comfortable.

Licorice Root Extract – A treasured botanical that helps promote a brighter, more even-looking complexion.

The Experience

A delicate botanical mist settles weightlessly onto the skin, delivering an instant feeling of freshness and comfort. Soft notes of rose create a subtle spa-like experience, making every application feel like a peaceful pause in your day.

How to Use

Mist generously onto clean skin before applying your serum or moisturizer, or spritz throughout the day whenever your skin needs a refreshing boost. Aura is perfect after cleansing, after sun exposure, during travel, over makeup, or anytime your complexion needs a moment of hydration and renewal.

Complete Your Ritual

Follow with Grace Anti-Aging Serum to lock in hydration, then finish with BALANCE Face Moisturizer for soft, nourished, radiant skin.

Ingredients (INCI)

Rosa Damascena Flower Water (Rose Hydrosol), Aqua (Distilled Water), Glycerin, Panthenol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Cucumis Sativus (Cucumber) Fruit Extract, Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Licorice) Root Extract, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice Powder, Lonicera Japonica (Honeysuckle) Flower Extract, Lonicera Caprifolium (Honeysuckle) Flower Extract, Benzyl Alcohol, Salicylic Acid, Glycerin, Sorbic Acid.

A Moment of Calm for Tired Skin

Some days your skin needs more than hydration—it needs a moment to recover.

Aura is an ultra-fine botanical recovery mist that delivers an instant veil of refreshing hydration while helping comfort, replenish, and revive tired skin. Thoughtfully crafted with rose hydrosol, panthenol, hyaluronic acid, cucumber, aloe, and soothing botanical extracts, every mist leaves skin feeling soft, balanced, and beautifully refreshed.

Whether used after cleansing, throughout the day, after time in the sun, during travel, or whenever your skin feels dry or warm, Aura transforms a simple spritz into a restorative botanical ritual.

Ultra-fine mist for effortless, even application

Instantly refreshes and hydrates

Helps comfort dry, stressed, and dehydrated skin

Lightweight, fast-absorbing, and never sticky

Perfect before moisturizer or anytime skin needs a boost

Rose Hydrosol – A beautifully aromatic floral water that refreshes and comforts the skin while providing lightweight hydration.

Panthenol (Pro-Vitamin B5) – Helps replenish moisture and supports a soft, healthy-looking complexion.

Hyaluronic Acid – Draws moisture to the skin, leaving it feeling plump, smooth, and refreshed.

Cucumber Extract – Known for its cooling, refreshing feel that helps revive tired-looking skin.

Aloe Vera – Delivers soothing hydration and helps skin feel calm and comfortable.

Licorice Root Extract – A treasured botanical that helps promote a brighter, more even-looking complexion.

A delicate botanical mist settles weightlessly onto the skin, delivering an instant feeling of freshness and comfort. Soft notes of rose create a subtle spa-like experience, making every application feel like a peaceful pause in your day.

How to Use

Mist generously onto clean skin before applying your serum or moisturizer, or spritz throughout the day whenever your skin needs a refreshing boost. Aura is perfect after cleansing, after sun exposure, during travel, over makeup, or anytime your complexion needs a moment of hydration and renewal.

Lustre begins with a spark—a burst of effervescent Cardamom that fills the air with a vibrant, spicy energy. This initial vitality is beautifully softened and illuminated by Orris, a uniquely powdery ingredient that adds a layer of luxurious romanticism, causing the fragrance to glow with a rich, elegant sheen. The white creaminess of Orris is further enhanced by the smooth, seamless presence of Sandalwood, which imparts a sense of perpetual grace and continuity to the composition.

As the fragrance settles, a delectable Vanilla embraces the scent with a warm, lingering sophistication, creating an unforgettable and sensual finish. Lustre is a poetic expression of light and longing, reflecting the desire to capture the present moment and make it last forever, until the end of time.

Top Notes: Cardamom, Orris

Middle Notes: Patchouli, Sandalwood, Cedarwood

Base Notes: Benzoin, Labdanum, Vanilla, Cypriol, Styrax, Tonka Bean, Myrrh

description.plain:
Caractéristiques :

  • Matière : fer
  • Format : lustre salon plafonnier circulaire 6 ampoules
  • Diamètre :45 cm
  • Tension : 220 V
  • Zone d'éclairage : 15 à 30 m²
  • Livraison standard offerte

Un lustre salon plafonnier fer 6 feux pour éclairer un grand salon sans suspension

Avec 6 sources lumineuses réparties sur 45 cm de diamètre, ce lustre salon plafonnier couvre jusqu'à 30 m² en éclairage principal. Pas de câble qui descend, pas de hauteur libre à sacrifier : le format plafonnier s'applique directement au plafond via une fixation DCL standard. Le fer brut donne à l'ensemble une présence visuelle forte, caractéristique du style rétro industriel. Dans un salon, un couloir large ou un espace ouvert cuisine-séjour, les 6 douilles offrent une diffusion homogène que deux ou trois ampoules n'atteignent pas.

Quelles ampoules choisir pour un rendu industriel authentique ?

Les ampoules filament type Edison (E27, 40 à 60 W) sont les plus adaptées à ce type de luminaire. Leur lumière chaude, autour de 2 200 à 2 700 K, renforce le côté usine et atelier du fer apparent. Optez pour un IRC supérieur à 80 pour restituer fidèlement les teintes de vos matériaux : bois, cuir, béton. Les versions LED filament consomment 6 à 8 W par ampoule, soit 36 à 48 W au total pour 6 feux, une consommation raisonnable pour la surface couverte. À noter : ce lustre salon plafonnier n'est pas dimmable en sortie de boîte ; si vous souhaitez varier l'intensité, il faut prévoir un variateur compatible sur le circuit électrique en amont.

Ce lustre salon plafonnier convient-il à un plafond bas ?

C'est précisément l'atout d'un plafonnier face à une suspension : la hauteur sous plafond n'est pas contrainte. Dès 2,40 m, ce format s'installe sans gêner la circulation. Le diamètre de 45 cm reste dans une proportion équilibrée pour une pièce de 15 à 20 m². Pour une surface de 25 à 30 m², il jouera le rôle d'éclairage principal à compléter par un ou deux points lumineux secondaires, lampadaire ou applique. La fixation s'effectue sur une rosace DCL : vérifiez que votre plafond dispose d'un boîtier d'encastrement de 60 mm de diamètre minimum avant la pose.

Ce lustre salon plafonnier résiste-t-il dans une cuisine ouverte ou une entrée ?

Le fer est un matériau robuste, mais il n'est pas traité IP pour les projections d'eau ou la vapeur intensive. Réservez ce luminaire aux zones sèches : salon, séjour, entrée, bureau ou chambre à plafond standard. Dans une cuisine ouverte, positionnez-le côté séjour plutôt qu'au-dessus de la plaque de cuisson. La finition fer brut peut présenter de légères variations de teinte d'un exemplaire à l'autre, c'est une caractéristique du matériau, non un défaut. Un chiffon sec suffit pour l'entretien courant ; évitez les produits abrasifs qui altèrent la surface.

Pour explorer d'autres luminaires de plafond fixes, consultez notre collection plafonnier. Vous préférez le métal sombre en décoration ? Retrouvez l'ensemble de nos références dans la collection lustre noir.

Aluminium brut, silhouette usine : un lustre cloche qui cadre immédiatement l'espace

Ce lustre cloche en aluminium concentre la lumière vers le bas sur 5 à 15 m², sans diffusion périphérique parasite. La cloche conique inversée est née dans les ateliers industriels du XXe siècle pour diriger l'éclairage précisément sur le plan de travail. Aujourd'hui, la même silhouette fonctionne au-dessus d'un îlot de cuisine, d'une table à manger ou d'un bureau, partout où vous avez besoin d'une lumière ciblée et d'une présence visuelle forte. Le métal aluminium donne une surface mate légèrement texturée, sobre au toucher, neutre avec les teintes béton, bois foncé ou enduit à la chaux. Ce luminaire s'intègre sans forcer dans un intérieur industriel, loft ou esprit atelier.

Comment choisir entre 22, 26 et 30 cm de diamètre ?

La proportion habituelle : le diamètre de l'abat-jour représente environ la moitié de la largeur de la surface éclairée. Pour une table de 60 cm, le modèle 22 cm suffit. Pour une table de 70 à 80 cm, préférez le 26 cm. Pour un îlot de 90 cm ou plus, le 30 cm couvre mieux la surface et maintient l'équilibre visuel. Un abat-jour sous-dimensionné se perd au-dessus d'une grande table ; un abat-jour surdimensionné alourdit l'ensemble dans une pièce étroite. La hauteur de 17 cm reste identique sur les trois tailles, ce qui homogénéise l'effet si vous suspendez plusieurs cloches en batterie au-dessus d'un long comptoir. Le câble de 120 cm ajustable vous permet de régler la hauteur entre environ 80 cm et 1,50 m sous plafond standard de 2,50 m. Comptez une hauteur d'abat-jour d'environ 70 à 80 cm au-dessus du plan de table pour un éclairage fonctionnel sans éblouissement direct.

Ce lustre cloche peut-il servir de lumière principale dans un salon ?

Honnêtement, non, pas seul. La cloche conique dirige le flux lumineux vers le bas avec un angle restreint. Elle éclaire efficacement une zone précise de 5 à 15 m², mais laisse les angles et les murs dans une pénombre marquée. En lumière principale pour un salon de 20 m², elle doit être complétée par un lampadaire ou des appliques murales. En revanche, au-dessus d'une table à manger ou d'un poste de travail, elle remplit parfaitement ce rôle sans appoint. Côté technique : culot E27 universel, compatible ampoules LED jusqu'à 60 W équivalent, non dimmable sauf si vous ajoutez un variateur de phase externe compatible E27, c'est la limite honnête à retenir avant l'achat. Tension universelle 90-260 V, utilisable sans adaptateur en Europe. L'ampoule n'est pas fournie : une LED E27 2700 K à 806 lm donne un rendu chaud et contrasté qui valorise la finition aluminium sombre.

Pour d'autres luminaires à finition sombre et câble ajustable, explorez la collection suspensions, ou consultez la collection lustre noir pour les modèles en noir mat et style industriel.

Ce lustre cloche en aluminium concentre la lumière vers le bas sur 5 à 15 m², sans diffusion périphérique parasite. La cloche conique inversée est née dans les ateliers industriels du XXe siècle pour diriger l'éclairage précisément sur le plan de travail. Aujourd'hui, la même silhouette fonctionne au-dessus d'un îlot de cuisine, d'une table à manger ou d'un bureau, partout où vous avez besoin d'une lumière ciblée et d'une présence visuelle forte. Le métal aluminium donne une surface mate légèrement texturée, sobre au toucher, neutre avec les teintes béton, bois foncé ou enduit à la chaux. Ce luminaire s'intègre sans forcer dans un intérieur industriel, loft ou esprit atelier.

Comment choisir entre 22, 26 et 30 cm de diamètre ?

La proportion habituelle : le diamètre de l'abat-jour représente environ la moitié de la largeur de la surface éclairée. Pour une table de 60 cm, le modèle 22 cm suffit. Pour une table de 70 à 80 cm, préférez le 26 cm. Pour un îlot de 90 cm ou plus, le 30 cm couvre mieux la surface et maintient l'équilibre visuel. Un abat-jour sous-dimensionné se perd au-dessus d'une grande table ; un abat-jour surdimensionné alourdit l'ensemble dans une pièce étroite. La hauteur de 17 cm reste identique sur les trois tailles, ce qui homogénéise l'effet si vous suspendez plusieurs cloches en batterie au-dessus d'un long comptoir. Le câble de 120 cm ajustable vous permet de régler la hauteur entre environ 80 cm et 1,50 m sous plafond standard de 2,50 m. Comptez une hauteur d'abat-jour d'environ 70 à 80 cm au-dessus du plan de table pour un éclairage fonctionnel sans éblouissement direct.

Ce lustre cloche peut-il servir de lumière principale dans un salon ?

Honnêtement, non, pas seul. La cloche conique dirige le flux lumineux vers le bas avec un angle restreint. Elle éclaire efficacement une zone précise de 5 à 15 m², mais laisse les angles et les murs dans une pénombre marquée. En lumière principale pour un salon de 20 m², elle doit être complétée par un lampadaire ou des appliques murales. En revanche, au-dessus d'une table à manger ou d'un poste de travail, elle remplit parfaitement ce rôle sans appoint. Côté technique : culot E27 universel, compatible ampoules LED jusqu'à 60 W équivalent, non dimmable sauf si vous ajoutez un variateur de phase externe compatible E27, c'est la limite honnête à retenir avant l'achat. Tension universelle 90-260 V, utilisable sans adaptateur en Europe. L'ampoule n'est pas fournie : une LED E27 2700 K à 806 lm donne un rendu chaud et contrasté qui valorise la finition aluminium sombre.

Pour d'autres luminaires à finition sombre et câble ajustable, explorez la collection suspensions, ou consultez la collection lustre noir pour les modèles en noir mat et style industriel.

Ce que le cristal K9 change dans votre salon

Ce lustre pissenlit en cristal K9 exploite un matériau à 22-24 % de plomb qui modifie l'indice de réfraction de manière mesurable. Contrairement au verre standard, la lumière traverse la matière avec plus de dispersion et d'éclat. Résultat concret : chaque pointe de la sphère renvoie un micro-faisceau lumineux sur vos murs. Dans un luminaire salon de format compact, cet effet est proportionnellement plus intense que dans un grand chandelier. La sphère de 40 cm couvre un volume visuel dense, ce qui renforce l'impression d'éclat à faible diamètre. À 2700 K avec des G9 LED blanc chaud, les reflets prennent une teinte dorée et chaleureuse. À 4000 K, l'éclat devient plus vif, presque glacé. Le choix de la température de couleur change radicalement l'ambiance ressentie, c'est une variable souvent sous-estimée avec ce type de luminaire.

Ce lustre pissenlit convient-il à un plafond bas ?

Le câble est ajustable jusqu'à 150 cm. Pour un plafond à 2,50 m, visez une hauteur de suspension laissant au moins 2,10 m dégagés sous le lustre, soit une descente maximale de 40 cm dans ce cas. La sphère mesure elle-même 40 cm de diamètre : prévoyez un volume aérien autour pour que les pointes ne semblent pas coincées. Dans un salon standard de 2,50 m de hauteur sous plafond, ce lustre pissenlit fonctionne à condition de raccourcir le câble. Pour des plafonds inférieurs à 2,40 m, ce format n'est pas recommandé. À noter : ce luminaire n'est pas dimmable en configuration standard, vérifiez la compatibilité de vos G9 LED avec votre installation avant achat.

8 douilles G9 : quelle puissance réelle pour couvrir 15 m² ?

Avec 8 ampoules G9 LED de 3 W chacune, vous atteignez 24 W au total. En LED 3 W, chaque source produit environ 250 à 300 lm, soit un flux total de 2 000 à 2 400 lm. C'est suffisant pour un éclairage d'ambiance dans un salon de 12 à 15 m² avec des murs clairs. Pour 15 m² aux murs sombres, passez aux G9 LED 4 W (32 W total, ~3 200 lm) pour maintenir un confort visuel correct. L'IRC du cristal K9 ne filtre pas la lumière, vous obtenez un rendu des couleurs proche de la source choisie, sans altération notable. Les ampoules restent dissimulées dans la structure du lustre pissenlit : aucune source visible à l'œil nu, uniquement l'effet de dispersion sur les parois.

Pour un éclairage de salon en cristal avec variation d'intensité, consultez notre collection lustre design, verrerie soufflée, cristal, prestige. Si vous cherchez un luminaire au style contemporain affirmé, notre collection lustre moderne propose des formats variés adaptés aux intérieurs actuels.

Protect your skin with double the defense. The PURITO Daily Soft Touch Sunscreen is a high-protection, lightweight sun solution with a silky, fast-absorbing texture. With SPF 50+ and PA++++, this sunscreen is formulated with dependable,
broad-spectrum UVA and UVB protection. Its complementary infusion of five different Ceramides also helps defend the skin barrier against external
stressors and offers the kind of deeply hydrated feeling skin loves. Our non-irritating Daily Soft Touch Sunscreen has a non-sticky,
matte finish that leaves zero white cast

Designed for double defense, the PURITO Daily Soft Touch Sunscreen joins the PURITO Daily Go-To Sunscreen in the Daily line. Created in collaboration with our community, the PURITO Daily Soft Touch Sunscreen was developed as a part of our Create Me program. Hundreds of community members participated in selecting the sun solution’s ingredients, design, and name. The formula underwent several rounds of thorough quality checks and rigorous testing throughout the development process to ensure reliable protection and performance.

This fast-absorbing, lightweight sunscreen best suits oily and combination skin types and delivers two-fold protection. In addition to broad spectrum SPF 50+ and PA++++ UV filters, the soft and silky formula is infused with a suite of five Ceramides that help strengthen the skin barrier. Ceramides NS, NP, AS, AP, and EOP work together to help shield the skin from environmental stressors and support the skin barrier with deep moisturization. The white-cast-free, non-irritating formula is also non-sticky and non-greasy.

 An additional four skin-loving ingredients create the ultimate curated complement. Centella Asiatica Extract, also known as Cica, helps to soothe any sensitive or irritated skin. Panthenol and Tocopherol assist with locking in moisture and protecting the skin from external stressors. Finally, Alpha-Bisabolol supports a more even complexion.

Key Ingredients
5 Ceramides
The five ceramides (NS, NP, AS, AP, and EOP) provide deep moisture, strengthen the skin barrier, and protect you against external stress. Simultaneously, they retain moisture, preventing water loss and leaving your skin feeling hydrated.

Centella
Centella effectively soothes sensitive and irritated skin, providing comforting relief.

Panthenol
Soothing Panthenol strengthens the skin barrier and leaves the skin moisturized.

How to Use
Use daily as the last step of your skincare routine.
Apply evenly on the face 15 minutes before sun exposure.
Reapply every two to three hours during the day and immediately after towel drying, swimming, or perspiring.

Ingredients
Water, Propanediol, Dibutyl Adipate, Dicaprylyl Carbonate, Diethylamino Hydroxybenzoyl Hexyl Benzoate, Ethylhexyl Triazone, Bis-Ethylhexyloxyphenol Methoxyphenyl Triazine, Amylopectin, Butylene Glycol, Methylene Bis-Benzotriazolyl Tetramethylbutylphenol, Glycerin, Behenyl Alcohol, Poly C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate, Polyglyceryl-3 Methylglucose Distearate, Sodium Acrylates Crosspolymer-2, Carbomer, Tromethamine, Decyl Glucoside, Acrylates/C10-30 Alkyl Acrylate Crosspolymer, (-)-alpha-bisabolol, Panthenol, Caprylhydroxamic Acid, Centella Asiatica Extract, Tocopherol, Ceramide NP, Dipropylene Glycol, Cholesterol, Propylene Glycol, Xanthan Gum, Glyceryl Stearate, Ceramide AS, Ceramide AP, Ceramide NS, Hydrogenated Lecithin, Ceramide EOP

Daily sunscreen that strengthens the skin barrier and protects against external stress.



Key Benefits

  • This sunscreen incorporates five types of ceramides (NS, NP, AS, AP, EOP) that deeply moisturize and protect the skin from external elements.
  • Centella extract effectively soothes sensitive and irritated skin, providing comforting relief.
  • Panthenol strengthens the skin barrier and keeps the skin hydrated.

FAQs

  • Q: What do SPF and PA mean?
  • A: SPF stands for "sun protection factor," which measures a sunscreen's ability to protect against UVB rays, while PA is a rating that indicates protection against UVA rays. Daily Soft Touch Sunscreen provides broad-spectrum protection with SPF 50+ and PA++++.
  • Q: Is this product reef-safe?
  • A: Yes, the Daily Soft Touch Sunscreen is made with reef-safe ingredients that do not harm coral reefs and marine life.
  • Q: Can I use this sunscreen on my kids?
  • A: While this sunscreen is gently formulated and clinically tested for sensitive skin, consulting with a pediatrician and conducting a patch test is still recommended to ensure compatibility.

Purito Daily Soft Touch Sunscreen SPF50+ 60ml is a daily sunscreen designed for outdoor protection with a soft, comfortable feel.

Described by Purito as a powerful outdoor sun shield, this SPF50+ PA++++ formula offers UVA and UVB protection with a non-sticky texture that leaves no white cast. It is enriched with five ceramides to help strengthen the skin barrier and provide moisture, centella to soothe sensitive and irritated skin, and panthenol to help keep skin moisturised. Hypoallergenic and dermatologist tested, it is vegan friendly, cruelty free and made without synthetic fragrance.

  • Non-sticky texture that leaves no white cast
  • Five ceramides help strengthen the skin barrier and provide moisture
  • Centella and panthenol help soothe and moisturise sensitive skin

Who is Purito Daily Soft Touch Sunscreen SPF50+ 60ml for?

Anyone with sensitive or easily irritated skin looking for a comfortable daily sunscreen for time outdoors.

description.plain:
PURITO Daily Soft Touch Sunscreen 60ml SPF50+ PA++++
Description

 

  • What do SPF and PA mean?

    SPF stands for "sun protection factor," which measures a sunscreen's ability to protect against UVB rays, while PA is a rating indicating protection against UVA rays. The Daily Soft Touch Sunscreen provides broad-spectrum protection with SPF 50+ and PA++++.

  • Is this product reef-safe?

    Yes, the Daily Soft Touch Sunscreen is free of ingredients harmful to coral reefs and marine life.

  • Can I use this sunscreen on my kids?

    While this sunscreen has been gently formulated and clinically tested for sensitive skin, we still recommend consulting with a pediatrician and conducting a patch test to ensure compatibility.

  • A vegan sun solution with a broad spectrum of SPF 50+ PA++++ to protect skin from harmful UV rays.
  • Infused with 5 different Ceramides (Ceramides NS, NP, AS, AP and EOP) to defend the skin barrier against external stressors and lock in moisture.
  • Enriched with Centella Asiatica Extract to calm and soothe sensitive and irritated skin.
  • Contains Tocopherol to seal in moisture and protect the skin from stress, Alpha-Bisabolo to brighten skin tone for a more even complexion, Panthenol to protect and strengthen the skin barrier.
  • The non-sticky formula dries to a matte finish that leaves no white cast.
  • Suitable for oily, combination skin types.
How to use
  • 1. At least 15 minutes before sun exposure, apply two-finger lengths of sunscreen on the face and neck.
  • 2. Apply generously to all other areas of skin exposed to sunlight.
  • 3. Reapply every two hours and immediately after swimming, towel drying, or extensive sweating.
  • Effortless, perfect protection

    Apply evenly to your skin as the final step in your skincare routine at least 15 minutes before sun exposure. Reapply as needed.

  • A necessity for outdoor activities

    Use it for outdoor activities like golfing, hiking, camping, surfing, and more.

 

Ingredients
  • 5 Ceramides

    The five ceramides (NS, NP, AS, AP, and EOP) provide deep moisture, strengthen the skin barrier, and protect you against external stress. Simultaneously, they retain moisture, preventing water loss and leaving your skin feeling hydrated.

  • Centella

    Centella effectively soothes sensitive and irritated skin, providing comforting relief.

  • Panthenol

    Soothing Panthenol strengthens the skin barrier and leaves the skin moisturized.

description.plain:
LED Face and Neck Mask by Aura Skin Lab is a modern beauty device designed to complement your regular facial and neck skincare routine. Its wearable design combines LED light technology with multiple light modes, providing a convenient at-home option for customers who want to incorporate light-based skincare into their personal beauty regimen.

The LED Face and Neck Mask is designed to provide convenient light exposure across the face and neck area in a wearable format. Its hands-free construction allows you to relax during your skincare session while following the recommended operating instructions for the selected light mode.

Featuring seven light modes, the LED Face and Neck Mask provides multiple settings that can be selected according to the manufacturer's recommended applications. The different modes add versatility to your skincare routine and allow you to choose the appropriate setting for your personal preferences and the intended cosmetic use of the device.

The LED Face and Neck Mask is suitable for at-home beauty routines and can be incorporated into either a morning or evening skincare schedule. Its wearable format makes it a convenient addition to a modern skincare collection, while its face-and-neck coverage provides a broader treatment area than devices designed exclusively for the face.

Aura Skin Lab presents the LED Face and Neck Mask as part of its branded skincare collection, combining contemporary beauty technology with a practical wearable design. The device can complement other appropriate skincare practices and can be used according to the recommended frequency and duration provided by the manufacturer.

For safe and effective use, carefully follow all manufacturer instructions regarding charging, cleaning, treatment duration, frequency, and light-mode selection. Use the device only as directed and follow any recommended eye-protection guidance. Customers with sensitive skin or specific concerns should review the product instructions before use.

The LED Face and Neck Mask offers a convenient way to introduce LED technology into a consistent personal skincare routine. Its multiple light modes, wearable construction, and face-and-neck coverage make it a versatile beauty accessory for customers interested in modern at-home skincare.

Este protector solar químico protege la piel de los rayos UV y ofrece diversos beneficios para el cuidado de la piel. Extracto de abedul de Inje enriquecido con aminoácidos, minerales y ácido hialurónico Vita que revitaliza e hidrata la piel.

Se adhiere perfectamente a la piel sin apelmazarse ni dejar un tono blanco.
Incluso ayuda a la adherencia de la base o base de maquillaje aplicada posteriormente.

Modo de Uso 

1. En la última etapa del cuidado de la piel, aplicar una cantidad moderada de producto sobre la piel y extender suavemente por todo el rostro.
2. Dé golpecitos ligeros para una mejor absorción.

Protect your skin with double the defense. The PURITO Daily Soft Touch Sunscreen is a high-protection, lightweight sun solution with a silky, fast-absorbing texture. With SPF 50+ and PA++++, this sunscreen is formulated with dependable,
broad-spectrum UVA and UVB protection. Its complementary infusion of five different Ceramides also helps defend the skin barrier against external
stressors and offers the kind of deeply hydrated feeling skin loves. Our non-irritating Daily Soft Touch Sunscreen has a non-sticky,
matte finish that leaves zero white cast

Designed for double defense, the PURITO Daily Soft Touch Sunscreen joins the PURITO Daily Go-To Sunscreen in the Daily line. Created in collaboration with our community, the PURITO Daily Soft Touch Sunscreen was developed as a part of our Create Me program. Hundreds of community members participated in selecting the sun solution’s ingredients, design, and name. The formula underwent several rounds of thorough quality checks and rigorous testing throughout the development process to ensure reliable protection and performance.

This fast-absorbing, lightweight sunscreen best suits oily and combination skin types and delivers two-fold protection. In addition to broad spectrum SPF 50+ and PA++++ UV filters, the soft and silky formula is infused with a suite of five Ceramides that help strengthen the skin barrier. Ceramides NS, NP, AS, AP, and EOP work together to help shield the skin from environmental stressors and support the skin barrier with deep moisturization. The white-cast-free, non-irritating formula is also non-sticky and non-greasy.

 An additional four skin-loving ingredients create the ultimate curated complement. Centella Asiatica Extract, also known as Cica, helps to soothe any sensitive or irritated skin. Panthenol and Tocopherol assist with locking in moisture and protecting the skin from external stressors. Finally, Alpha-Bisabolol supports a more even complexion.

Key Ingredients
5 Ceramides
The five ceramides (NS, NP, AS, AP, and EOP) provide deep moisture, strengthen the skin barrier, and protect you against external stress. Simultaneously, they retain moisture, preventing water loss and leaving your skin feeling hydrated.

Centella
Centella effectively soothes sensitive and irritated skin, providing comforting relief.

Panthenol
Soothing Panthenol strengthens the skin barrier and leaves the skin moisturized.

How to Use
Use daily as the last step of your skincare routine.
Apply evenly on the face 15 minutes before sun exposure.
Reapply every two to three hours during the day and immediately after towel drying, swimming, or perspiring.

WATER COMPLEX SUNSCREEN SPF 50 PA++++

Crème solaire hydratante SPF 50 PA++++ pour le visage

Water Complex Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++++ est une crème solaire hydratante haute protection conçue pour protéger la peau des rayons UVA et UVB tout en renforçant la barrière cutanée. Véritable soin quotidien, elle associe une protection solaire à large spectre à des actifs hydratants et réparateurs afin de préserver l'équilibre de la peau face aux agressions environnementales responsables du photovieillissement, de la déshydratation et des taches pigmentaires liées au soleil.

Sa formule enrichie en acide hyaluronique et en Peptides (2 %) procure une hydratation immédiate, aide à maintenir l'eau au cœur de l'épiderme et soutient la fonction barrière de la peau. Les peptides issus de biotechnologie contribuent à améliorer visiblement la qualité de la peau, tandis que les filtres UV photostables offrent une protection quotidienne contre les effets nocifs des UVA et UVB.

Grâce à sa texture légère, invisible et non grasse, Water Complex Sunscreen SPF 50 PA++++ s'applique facilement, ne laisse pas de film blanc et constitue une excellente base de maquillage. Une utilisation quotidienne aide à préserver un teint plus uniforme, à améliorer l'apparence des pores et à limiter l'apparition des signes visibles du vieillissement cutané induits par le soleil.

Adaptée aux peaux normales, mixtes à grasses et déshydratées, cette crème solaire visage SPF 50 PA++++ est idéale pour une utilisation quotidienne, été comme hiver, afin d'assurer une protection optimale tout en maintenant une peau hydratée, confortable et éclatante.

FAQs

  • Q: What do SPF and PA mean?
  • A: SPF stands for "sun protection factor," which measures a sunscreen's ability to protect against UVB rays, while PA is a rating that indicates protection against UVA rays. Daily Soft Touch Sunscreen provides broad-spectrum protection with SPF 50+ and PA++++.
  • Q: Is this product reef-safe?
  • A: Yes, the Daily Soft Touch Sunscreen is made with reef-safe ingredients that do not harm coral reefs and marine life.
  • Q: Can I use this sunscreen on my kids?
  • A: While this sunscreen is gently formulated and clinically tested for sensitive skin, consulting with a pediatrician and conducting a patch test is still recommended to ensure compatibility.

Glow-boosting serum with an advanced form of vitamin C, clinically proven to visibly brighten, smooth, and reduce discoloration — Boosted by vitamin E & ferulic acid, with chamomile and konjac root to calm and protect.

  • Vitamin C (Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate) - A highly stable, barrier-safe form of vitamin C that delivers visibly brighter skin and improved texture. It absorbs efficiently, stays active longer, and is ideal for daily use — perfect for acne-prone skin.

  • Konjac Root + Chamomile - These calming botanicals help soothe skin and reduce visible redness while supporting a healthy moisture barrier.

Aura Hair Shampoo

A straight cleanser that lifts clay, wax, gel and a day of sweat without leaving the hair squeaking. This is the wash before a cut and the wash after a styling session.

Why barbers keep it on the back bar

  • Clears styling product in one or two passes
  • Cleans without stripping the scalp
  • Rinses fast, no film left behind
  • Leaves hair easy to comb and cut

Specs

Size 300 ml, back-bar size
Type Everyday cleanser, no residue
Apply to Fully soaked hair, scalp first
Amount Dime-sized on short hair, more on length
Passes One on clean hair, two when there is product to break
Frequency 2 to 3 times a week for most clients

Soak the hair before the shampoo goes anywhere near it. Half-wet hair foams less, so people pour more and then wash daily to keep up — that strips the scalp and it answers with more oil, not less. Water does half the work. Rinse until it runs clear.

A Moment of Calm for Tired Skin

Some days your skin needs more than hydration—it needs a moment to recover.

Aura is an ultra-fine botanical recovery mist that delivers an instant veil of refreshing hydration while helping comfort, replenish, and revive tired skin. Thoughtfully crafted with rose hydrosol, panthenol, hyaluronic acid, cucumber, aloe, and soothing botanical extracts, every mist leaves skin feeling soft, balanced, and beautifully refreshed.

Whether used after cleansing, throughout the day, after time in the sun, during travel, or whenever your skin feels dry or warm, Aura transforms a simple spritz into a restorative botanical ritual.

Why You'll Love It

Ultra-fine mist for effortless, even application

Instantly refreshes and hydrates

Helps comfort dry, stressed, and dehydrated skin

Lightweight, fast-absorbing, and never sticky

Perfect before moisturizer or anytime skin needs a boost

Suitable for all skin types

Botanical Highlights

Rose Hydrosol – A beautifully aromatic floral water that refreshes and comforts the skin while providing lightweight hydration.

Panthenol (Pro-Vitamin B5) – Helps replenish moisture and supports a soft, healthy-looking complexion.

Hyaluronic Acid – Draws moisture to the skin, leaving it feeling plump, smooth, and refreshed.

Cucumber Extract – Known for its cooling, refreshing feel that helps revive tired-looking skin.

Aloe Vera – Delivers soothing hydration and helps skin feel calm and comfortable.

Licorice Root Extract – A treasured botanical that helps promote a brighter, more even-looking complexion.

The Experience

A delicate botanical mist settles weightlessly onto the skin, delivering an instant feeling of freshness and comfort. Soft notes of rose create a subtle spa-like experience, making every application feel like a peaceful pause in your day.

How to Use

Mist generously onto clean skin before applying your serum or moisturizer, or spritz throughout the day whenever your skin needs a refreshing boost. Aura is perfect after cleansing, after sun exposure, during travel, over makeup, or anytime your complexion needs a moment of hydration and renewal.

Complete Your Ritual

Follow with Grace Anti-Aging Serum to lock in hydration, then finish with BALANCE Face Moisturizer for soft, nourished, radiant skin.

Ingredients (INCI)

Rosa Damascena Flower Water (Rose Hydrosol), Aqua (Distilled Water), Glycerin, Panthenol, Sodium Hyaluronate, Cucumis Sativus (Cucumber) Fruit Extract, Glycyrrhiza Glabra (Licorice) Root Extract, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice Powder, Lonicera Japonica (Honeysuckle) Flower Extract, Lonicera Caprifolium (Honeysuckle) Flower Extract, Benzyl Alcohol, Salicylic Acid, Glycerin, Sorbic Acid.

description.plain:
Aura Hair Shampoo

A straight cleanser that lifts clay, wax, gel and a day of sweat without leaving the hair squeaking. This is the wash before a cut and the wash after a styling session.

Why barbers keep it on the back bar

  • Clears styling product in one or two passes
  • Cleans without stripping the scalp
  • Rinses fast, no film left behind
  • Leaves hair easy to comb and cut

Specs

Size 300 ml, back-bar size
Type Everyday cleanser, no residue
Apply to Fully soaked hair, scalp first
Amount Dime-sized on short hair, more on length
Passes One on clean hair, two when there is product to break
Frequency 2 to 3 times a week for most clients

Soak the hair before the shampoo goes anywhere near it. Half-wet hair foams less, so people pour more and then wash daily to keep up — that strips the scalp and it answers with more oil, not less. Water does half the work. Rinse until it runs clear.

A straight cleanser that lifts clay, wax, gel and a day of sweat without leaving the hair squeaking. This is the wash before a cut and the wash after a styling session.

Why barbers keep it on the back bar

  • Clears styling product in one or two passes
  • Cleans without stripping the scalp
  • Rinses fast, no film left behind
  • Leaves hair easy to comb and cut

Specs

Size 300 ml, back-bar size
Type Everyday cleanser, no residue
Apply to Fully soaked hair, scalp first
Amount Dime-sized on short hair, more on length
Passes One on clean hair, two when there is product to break
Frequency 2 to 3 times a week for most clients

Soak the hair before the shampoo goes anywhere near it. Half-wet hair foams less, so people pour more and then wash daily to keep up — that strips the scalp and it answers with more oil, not less. Water does half the work. Rinse until it runs clear.

The listed oil is derived from Argania spinosa kernels. Cold pressing describes mechanical extraction without added heat. The extraction method and the ingredient origin are useful details when comparing oils for your routine.

Keep your care routine simple

Follow the pack’s directions for external use. Start with a small amount and patch test before wider use. Avoid the product if you are allergic to argan and check the current label for any other allergen information.

Choose by intended use

Culinary and cosmetic oil specifications should not be treated as interchangeable. Until the current product specification confirms food use, do not use this page as a recommendation to consume the oil.

Before you use it

For external cosmetic use. Patch test before use and stop if irritation occurs. If you have a nut allergy, check the current label and seek advice before use. Store closed, away from heat and direct sunlight. Keep out of reach of children.

description.plain: Carrot is not a note most fragrance houses would risk naming outright, and Happy Heart Perfume includes it without apology. Cucumber, mandarin orange and cassia open this Eau de Parfum crisp and slightly spiced, an unusual pairing of vegetal freshness against citrus warmth. Water hyacinth and carrot fill the middle, an unconventional combination that reads more green than sweet. White woods and sandalwood settle into a soft, clean base. Clinique classifies this Happy Heart Eau de Parfum as fresh green, built for daytime wear, easy and understated in a way that matches the brand's dermatologist-friendly reputation. Carrot seed, the actual material used here rather than the vegetable itself, brings a dry, slightly woody, orris-adjacent character in perfumery quite different from what the raw vegetable might suggest, and it's precisely this unexpected register that keeps Happy Heart from smelling like a novelty note experiment. The carrot note is the main point of interest here: earthy rather than sweet, it keeps the whole composition from reading as just another interchangeable citrus-floral built for an office desk drawer, one of Clinique's more conceptually interesting fragrance releases still, despite the brand's overall reputation for straightforward simplicity, proof the house is capable of more conceptual ambition than its mainstream image suggests.

• 隨著年齡增長，體內的膠原蛋白會自然流失，直接反映在肌膚緊緻度、關節靈活度以及秀髮的強韌度上。Dr. Berg 多重膠原蛋白胜肽粉 為您帶來全方位的逆齡解決方案！每份大手筆注入高達 15.5克 頂級膠原蛋白胜肽，完美揉合草飼、牧場飼養牛皮及深海野生捕撈三大優質源頭，純淨無污染，身體更好吸收。
      這款進階胜肽複合配方一次過網羅 I、II、III、V、X 型共 5 種必需膠原蛋白，全方位照顧由內到外的健康。特別添加維他命 C 與生物素 (Biotin)，協同激活體內膠原蛋白合成。無味粉末設計，能完美融入您每日的咖啡、茶、果昔（Smoothie）或溫水中，是都市人維持彈性肌膚、柔順秀髮、強韌指甲與關節活力的 All-in-One 每日必備超級食物。
      🌟 5 大核心全效科研優勢
      • 5重膠原蛋白網羅 (I, II, III, V, X 型)：市面大多產品只含 1-2 種膠原蛋白。Dr. Berg 首創五合一複合配方，全方位守護肌膚組織（I, III型）、關節軟骨（II型）及細胞微生態（V, X型）。
      • 15.5g 超高純度胜肽：每份提供足量 15.5 克優質胜肽，分子細小、生物利用度極高，能快速直達身體所需部位，高效補充流失營養。
      • 三大純淨優質源頭：100% 嚴選自天然草飼、放牧牛隻及深海野生捕撈來源。拒絕化學添加，不含抗生素或重金屬風險。
      • 維他命C X 生物素黃金協同：
        • 90mg 維他命C：促進體內膠原蛋白自身合成，強效抗氧化，維持肌膚亮澤。
        • 60mcg 生物素 (Biotin)：維持頭髮與指甲強韌生長的核心維他命，告別易斷裂與毛躁。
      • cGMP 最高標準製造：在美國 cGMP 認證的頂級設施中生產，經過第三方嚴格安全測試，不含填充劑、防腐劑與人工香料。
      💡 為什麼需要「多重」膠原蛋白？
      不同的膠原蛋白類型在體內各司其職。普通膠原蛋白只能針對皮膚或關節做單一補充，而 Dr. Berg 多重膠原蛋白胜肽兼顧了「美肌、美髮、強韌指甲、關節柔軟度」。一罐粉末全面取代您的多瓶裝補充劑，對於吞嚥膠囊有困難的人士，或是追求高效能 All-in-One 保健的精緻 OL 來說，這是最科學、最方便的逆齡新選擇。
      📝 產品規格與食用方法
      • 產品名稱：Dr. Berg 多重膠原蛋白胜肽粉 (Multi-Collagen Peptides)
      • 包裝容量：25 份 / 罐 (每份含 15.5 克膠原蛋白)
      • 主要成分：水解牛皮膠原蛋白肽（草飼與牧場飼養）、深海野生捕撈魚膠原蛋白肽、雞骨濃縮物、蛋殼膜膠原蛋白、維他命 C（抗壞血酸）、生物素。
      • 適用對象：希望維持肌膚緊緻彈性、指甲易斷裂、秀髮欠缺光澤、欲保持關節柔軟度與日常活動能力之人士。
      • 食用方法：每日 1 勺（約 15.5 克），加入約 250ml 的暖水、咖啡、茶、果汁或果昔中，攪拌均勻後即可享用。其無特殊氣味的配方完全不會破壞飲品原本的風味。
      • 儲存注意：使用後請重新密封，乾燥劑請保持在罐內，並存放於陰涼乾燥的地方，避免潮濕結塊。
      ⚠️ 溫馨提示 (Disclaimer)
      本產品為日常膳食補充劑（保健食品）。本產品並非用於診斷、治療、治癒或預防任何疾病。孕婦、哺乳期婦女、或正在接受特定藥物治療人士，請在服用前諮詢醫生意見。本產品含有源自魚類、雞肉及蛋類成分，過敏人士請留意。
      🧪 Dr. Berg Multi-Collagen FAQ :
      Q1：這款產品含有 I、II、III、V、X 型共 5 種膠原蛋白，它們各自有什麼功效？

      A1：市面上普通的膠原蛋白大多只含 1 種，而 Dr. Berg 首創五合一複合配方，每一種型態都在身體各司其職，為您帶來 All-in-One 的全方位護航：

      I 型 (Type I)：人體內含量最多，是維持肌膚彈性、緊緻度，以及強韌指甲的核心結構。
      II 型 (Type II)：主要存在於軟骨中，是維持關節活動靈活度、柔軟度與舒適度的黃金成分。
      III 型 (Type III)：與 I 型協同運作，主要負責保持肌膚組織的飽滿豐盈，打造水嫩水光肌。
      V 型 (Type V)：支持細胞表面的微生態健康，協同生物素一同由內修護，強韌秀髮、減少毛躁。
      X 型 (Type X)：專門針對關節與骨骼健康的基質，配合 II 型共同發揮作用，適合注重長遠行動力的都市人。


      Q2：裡面有野生捕撈的魚類來源，飲起來會不會有很重的魚腥味或牛皮怪味？

      A2：請完全放心！我們採用了頂級的純淨水解工藝與微粉化提純技術，徹底去除了原材料中的雜質與異味。這款膠原蛋白粉呈現完全無添加、無特殊氣味的純淨狀態。不論是加入朝早的熱咖啡、奶茶、綠茶，還是下午茶的果昔（Smoothie）中，它都能完美溶解，絕對不會破壞您飲品原本的風味。

      Q3：為什麼這款產品要特別添加維他命 C 和生物素 (Biotin)？

      A3：單純補充膠原蛋白是不夠的，身體需要「催化劑」才能高效吸收。

      90mg 維他命C：是體內自身合成膠原蛋白不可或缺的黃金元素，更能強效抗氧化，幫助維持面色亮澤。
      60mcg 生物素：美容界公認的「美髮美甲維他命」，能有效修護易斷裂的指甲，並讓秀髮維持柔順光澤。

      這款黃金協同配方，讓您不需要額外再吃多瓶維他命，一步到位完成每日美顏護航。

      Q4：什麼是「水解膠原蛋白胜肽」？它的吸收效果真的比較好嗎？

      A4：普通食物（如豬腳、花膠）中的膠原蛋白分子量極大，未經消化便會被排出體外。Dr. Berg 採用尖端水解技術，將大分子膠原蛋白切割成微分子結構的「胜肽 (Peptides)」型態。胜肽分子極小，生物利用度極高，不需要經過漫長的胃酸分解，就能直接被身體快速吸收，精準直達肌膚、秀髮與關節所需。

      Q5：每天最推薦在什麼時間飲用？可以用熱水沖調嗎？

      A5：不論任何時間飲用皆可，但最推薦在早晨空腹，或晚上睡前一小時服用。此時身體的修復機能最活躍，吸收率最理想。我們的水解胜肽粉質結構非常穩定，完全可以用熱咖啡、熱茶或暖水沖調，高溫並不會破壞其胜肽結構，讓您隨心調配喜愛的日常特飲。

      Q6：一罐裡面一共有多少份？可以飲用多久？

      A6：每罐 Dr. Berg 多重膠原蛋白胜肽粉精準提供 25 份（隨罐附送專用量匙）。每匙分量高達 15.5 克，補充足量營養。按照每日服用 1 勺的標準日常保健計算，一罐可供連續飲用接近一個月。

description.plain:
Native Collagen Booster is a comprehensive plant-based collagen powder that supplies your body with proven Amino Acids (in the same ratio as type 1 collagen naturally produced by our bodies) ready to be absorbed and used for collagen synthesis. 

This vegan formula ups the ante on traditional collagen supplements by preventing collagen depletion and enhancing the absorption of collagen and nutrients. 

Blended with:

  • Vegan Collagen – vegan amino acid complex that mimics Type 1 collagen
  • Vitamin C & pro-vitamin A-rich superfruits – building blocks for collagen production (Australian native Kakadu Plum & Hibiscus)
  • Antioxidants – to prevent existing collagen from breaking down (Australian native Mountain Pepper Berry, Sea Buckthorn, Macqui Berry, Quandong)
  • Prebiotics – to assist with gut health and nutrient absorption (Baobab)

It differs from traditional beef and marine collagen as it is:

  • Pure – plant-based, vegan and cruelty-free; you won't find heavy metals or animal products in this formula
  • Highly absorbable – Traditional collagen (sourced from fish scales or cow hides) cannot be absorbed by the body and must be hydrolysed to free the amino acids. Native Collagen Booster provides the Amino Acids in an already isolated form so they are ready to be absorbed. Also contains prebiotics to further support nutrient absorption.
  • Naturally boosts collagen – not only provides the exact Amino Acid Complex of Collagen directly to the body, but also provides the body with the building blocks needed to stimulate the production of its own collagen naturally.
  • Prevents collagen depletion – provides potent antioxidants to protect existing collagen stores from depletion.

description.plain:
Not all collagen products are created equal

Collagen is found extensively throughout the body, playing a critical role in the composition and function of various tissues. In a nutshell, collagen helps form the foundation of our skin, bones, hair, nails and connective tissues. It is the glue that holds everything together.

People often consider collagen as the fountain of youth, as it unfortunately diminishes with age. When collagen declines, our skin, hair and joints start showing those tell-tale signs of aging. For this reason, collagen supplementation has become increasingly popular. But keep in mind that not all collagen supplements are created equal.

Here are four things you should know about collagen: 

1. Collagen is the most abundant protein in the body. Collagen can be found in our muscles, teeth, muscles, cartilage, tendons and ligaments and in the lining of our arteries, organs and intestines. Collagen makes up: 

  • 25-35% of your body's overall protein content
  • 75% of the skin
  • 90% of the protein in bone

2. Collagen gets depleted as we age. Collagen production begins to decline in our mid-to-late 20s and early 30s. After that, we start losing collagen at a rate of 1% per year. This reduction is why skin sags and wrinkles appear the older we get. It is why our hair and nails change over time and why our bones and joints get stiff. Here is a breakdown by age:

  • By 25, we start losing 1% of collagen production
  • 50, we have lost an estimated 25% of our body's collagen. 
  • By 75, that number climbs to 50%. 

The rate of decline in collagen production can vary from person to person, and it depends on multiple factors, including genetics, overall health and environmental influences, such as sun exposure, smoking and poor diet. 

3. Collagen has many benefits. The main ones we are most focused on here are its ability to support hair, skin and nail health while also bolstering bone and joint health.

4. Collagen comes in many different types. Did you know there are 28 different types of collagen found in the human body? Here are some quick facts about the five main types: 

  • 90% of the body's total collagen is Type I, which is crucial for skin, bones, tendons, and connective tissues.
  • Type II is found in elastic cartilage.
  • Type III works with Type I in skin and muscles.
  • Type V supports skin and hair health.
  • Type X is vital for bone formation and cartilage integrity.
Why Choose Multi-Source Collagen Peptides?

Not all collagen products are created equal, nor are they all derived from the same sources. Multi-Source Collagen Peptides from Trailhead Nutrition® was carefully crafted with a blend of five types of collagen (I, II, III, V and X), sourced from the highest-quality ingredients, including Grass-Fed Collagen Hydrolysate Peptides, Instantized Chicken Bone Collagen, Hydrolyzed Marine Collagen, and Natural Egg Shell Collagen Membrane. This advanced formula is available in an unflavored, easy-to-mix powder that contains no artificial flavors, colors, or sweeteners, making it a fantastic way to boost your collagen intake.

Extensively researched, collagen peptides are known for their superior absorption and efficacy in promoting hair, skin, and nail health, and supporting bone and joint health. Whether you want to enhance your daily health routine or need a low-calorie protein boost, Multi-Source Collagen Peptides provides a simple solution. Mix it into your morning coffee, a smoothie, or just water for a powerful way to support your body.

Don't let age change you. Change the way you age. With Multi-Source Collagen Peptides, you're not just buying a supplement; you're investing in your overall well-being from head to toe(nail). Try it today! Your body will thank you.

Key benefits of Multi-Source Collagen Peptides:

  • SUPPORTS HAIR, SKIN, AND NAIL HEALTH
  • SUPPORTS BONE AND JOINT HEALTH
  • NO ARTIFICIAL FLAVORS, COLORS, OR SWEETENERS

description.plain:
Fill a large room with the Maple Butter 3-Wick Candle from Goose Creek, a highly scented candle poured from our proprietary soy wax blend. Each 14.5 oz jar burns up to 45 hours across three 100% lead-free wicks.

Product details

  • Proprietary soy wax blend
  • Net weight 14.5 oz (411 g)
  • Up to 45 hours of burn time
  • 3 wicks, 100% lead-free
  • Scent family: Bakery
  • Highly scented with premium fragrance oils and essential oils

How to use

Light all three wicks every time you burn the candle. On the first burn, let it run 2 to 3 hours so the wax melts all the way to the edge of the jar. That full melt pool is what prevents tunneling later. Trim the wicks to 1/4 inch before each burn, and keep sessions to 3 hours or less.

Why three wicks

Three wicks melt wax across the full width of the jar instead of a narrow channel down the center. That wider melt pool releases more fragrance at once, so a 3-wick candle scents a large, open room faster than a single-wick candle of the same size. Burning only one or two wicks shrinks the melt pool and cuts the scent throw the candle was built to deliver.

Burn safely: place the candle on a heat-resistant, sturdy surface away from drafts, windows, and air vents. Keep candles out of reach of children and pets, and never leave a burning candle unattended.

Making a cup of Coffee is my favorite morning ritual. I jump out of bed at sunrise, when the house is dark and quiet, and I head to the kitchen. All I can hear is the roosters down at the orchard, and I have a moment with myself as the rich aroma floats all the way through the house.

I’m obsessed with Coffee. And it took us years to get it right. Our Medium Roast is a rich dance of flavors: toasted Cacao, Toffee, Ripe Cherry, and poised acidity. Our beans are sustainably grown in lush soil by Coffee farmers in Guatemala and Colombia, who are paid a verified living wage and provided with stable, long-term demand to support their livelihood and communities.

Roasted to preserve freshness, this Coffee is crafted to be used within three weeks. The result is an exceptionally nuanced smell and taste, and a Coffee that I've always dreamed of making. Standing for something strong, from farmers we know and love.

x Richard

Packaged in a paper pouch*
